citations.assessment: The Bavli gives Afes and the Yerushalmi gives Pas of the South in parallel accounts of Ḥanina’s appointment. The Yerushalmi also names an anonymous elder. The equivalence is Heilprin’s identification.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
